source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school final examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Final Examination - 2017-2018', 'MATHEMATICS', 'Std. : VIII', 'Time : 2 hrs. + 15 min.', 'F. M. : 80'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no usable text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A (40 marks, Q1-Q4) is compulsory; Section B (40 marks) asks to attempt any FOUR of Q5-Q10, so the listed marks add up to more than 80. 6(a), 8(a) and 8(c) print no marks (stored as 0, flagged). Fractions, powers and roots were rebuilt inline from the page layout. The paper's own typos (e.g. 'he' for 'the', 'last number of revolutions', 'P = 40') are kept as printed. Chapter null: 4(a), 9(a) (direct/inverse variation) and 7(a) (time and work), which have no matching chapter in the list. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
